components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional honorific for the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input; it is normalized with the
            same rules as 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 600'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied the
            returned value is the composed, normalized structured address (normalized addressLine1,
            then a single space and the normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), it must fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Retained write-only request flag; not persisted. Duplicate detection is now the
            single identity key (which includes the telephone), so two owners with the same last name
            and postcode but different telephones are no longer a household duplicate and are created
            as a soft match regardless of this flag. The flag no longer affects duplicate detection.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true and retains the record. Soft-deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName when a title was supplied, or just the lastName otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A per-owner customer reference formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared household identifier — the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode receive the same value automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent
                for owners without a postcode (not in any household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key — the lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where telephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName) is
                the American Soundex code of the last name. Creating an owner whose identity key equals
                an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3b1f...'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created, i.e. excluding this
                owner. Zero when the name was unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: A per-owner membership reference formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by
                the year it ends in).
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year
                runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by the year it ends in, so a registrationDate on or
                after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following June.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, scored at creation starting at 0; adds 2 when
                an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more (its
                householdId is shared with at least two earlier owners; an owner with no postcode is a
                household of one); adds 3 when tenure (whole elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate
                to today) is 1 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, banded from membershipPoints -
                0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3, and 6 or more is level 4. A
                newly created owner has zero tenure, so it scores at most 5 points and never reaches
                level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode range first (NSW 2000-2099, VIC
                3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the fixed city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no
                known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the current
                business day (a high-volume sign-up day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner's lastName has the same Soundex code as this owner's
                and shares this owner's postcode but whose identity key differs — a soft match that was
                still created — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same postcode and same
                Soundex of lastName, different identity key). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, beyond which a create is rejected),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their fields; 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against their
                'registrationDate'; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or
                over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          items:

        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      properties:
        message:

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        - id

          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional honorific for the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input; it is normalized with the
            same rules as 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 600'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied the
            returned value is the composed, normalized structured address (normalized addressLine1,
            then a single space and the normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), it must fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Retained write-only request flag; not persisted. Duplicate detection is now the
            single identity key (which includes the telephone), so two owners with the same last name
            and postcode but different telephones are no longer a household duplicate and are created
            as a soft match regardless of this flag. The flag no longer affects duplicate detection.

          example: false

            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'

            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'

            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: A per-owner member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode/city, FY is the 2-digit fiscal year
                of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized telephone and last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed
                over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared household identifier — the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode receive the same value automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent
                for owners without a postcode (not in any household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key — the lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where telephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName) is
                the American Soundex code of the last name. Creating an owner whose identity key equals
                an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3b1f...'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created, i.e. excluding this
                owner. Zero when the name was unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: A per-owner membership reference formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by
                the year it ends in).
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year
                runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by the year it ends in, so a registrationDate on or
                after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following June.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, scored at creation starting at 0; adds 2 when
                an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more (its
                householdId is shared with at least two earlier owners; an owner with no postcode is a
                household of one); adds 3 when tenure (whole elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate
                to today) is 1 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, banded from membershipPoints -
                0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3, and 6 or more is level 4. A
                newly created owner has zero tenure, so it scores at most 5 points and never reaches
                level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode range first (NSW 2000-2099, VIC
                3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the fixed city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no
                known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the current
                business day (a high-volume sign-up day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner's lastName has the same Soundex code as this owner's

                still created — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same postcode and same
                Soundex of lastName, different identity key). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                true.
              type: integer

              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:

              type: boolean

              type: string
              enum:

              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:

              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9

              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:

              type: array

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional honorific for the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input; it is normalized with the
            same rules as 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 600'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied the
            returned value is the composed, normalized structured address (normalized addressLine1,
            then a single space and the normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), it must fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Retained write-only request flag; not persisted. Duplicate detection is now the
            single identity key (which includes the telephone), so two owners with the same last name
            and postcode but different telephones are no longer a household duplicate and are created
            as a soft match regardless of this flag. The flag no longer affects duplicate detection.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true and retains the record. Soft-deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName when a title was supplied, or just the lastName otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: A per-owner member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode/city, FY is the 2-digit fiscal year
                of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized telephone and last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed
                over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared household identifier — the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode receive the same value automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent
                for owners without a postcode (not in any household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key — the lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where telephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName) is
                the American Soundex code of the last name. Creating an owner whose identity key equals
                an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3b1f...'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created, i.e. excluding this
                owner. Zero when the name was unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year
                runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by the year it ends in, so a registrationDate on or
                after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following June.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, scored at creation starting at 0; adds 2 when
                an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more (its
                householdId is shared with at least two earlier owners; an owner with no postcode is a
                household of one); adds 3 when tenure (whole elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate
                to today) is 1 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, banded from membershipPoints -
                0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3, and 6 or more is level 4. A
                newly created owner has zero tenure, so it scores at most 5 points and never reaches
                level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode range first (NSW 2000-2099, VIC
                3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the fixed city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no
                known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
